sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Expatriate Worker Cross-Border Money Transmission Service

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (based on the Spanish legal tradition) with limited bifurcated commercial and maritime law elements; not a common-law or Islamic-law jurisdiction
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Panama–United States Trade Promotion Agreement (TPA), in force since 31 October 2012
European Union–Central America Association Agreement, applicable to Panama
Panama–Mexico Free Trade Agreement, in force since 1 July 2019

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley No. 23 de 27 de abril de 2015, as amended by Ley No. 70 de 2019 and Decree No. 406 de 2020, implementing AML/CFT obligations for obliged entities; Ley No. 52 de 27 de octubre de 2016, as amended, and its regulatory framework (Decreto Ejecutivo No. 164 de 2016 and implementing resolutions of the Dirección General del Registro Público) creating the non-public Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) register; Resoluciones of the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF), including Resolution No. 2018-47 on customer due diligence, beneficial ownership, and politically exposed persons; Código Penal, Articles 254–282, defining money-laundering predicate offenses.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of certificate of incorporation and incumbency certificate of any foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or chamber of commerce in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized power of attorney in favor of the Panama registered agent and legal counsel
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of execution followed by the competent Hague Apostille or consular legalization authority

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport and proof of residential address of each beneficial owner, director, and authorized signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or consular officer in the jurisdiction of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Spanish translation, by a Panama certified public translator, of the apostilled or legalized foreign-language documents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Panama certified public translator (Traductor Público Autorizado), attached to the authenticated original

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of every shareholder, director, UBO, authorized signatory, and high-risk intermediary against the OFAC SDN and non-SDN lists, UN Security Council consolidated list, EU consolidated financial sanctions list, UK HMT consolidated list, and the consolidated AML/CFT lists maintained by the Panamanian Unidad de Análisis Financiero. Enhanced due diligence is required for all politically exposed persons, including family members and close associates, with source-of-funds and source-of-wealth verification. Negative-media searches, criminal-history checks, sanctions-list monitoring, and client risk rating must be completed before incorporation. Client files must be retained for at least six years after the business relationship ends.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá — Sistema de Consulta y Reserva de Nombres en Línea (https://www.registropublico.gob.pa)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All Panamanian corporate denominations are recorded in Spanish and, for names originally formulated in a foreign language or non-Latin script, a certified romanization/transliteration must be filed together with a certified Spanish translation of the intended commercial name. The name must end with the words 'Sociedad Anónima' or the abbreviation 'S.A.', must be distinctive, must not be identical or deceptively similar to an existing registered name, must not be contrary to law, public order, or morality, and, if it contains an activity-regulated term, must be accompanied by evidence of the corresponding governmental authorization.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant or registered agent must file, within five business days from notification, a detailed written 'recurso de reconsideración' with the Dirección General del Registro Público through the official registry office, annexing the denial notice, the reserved name copy, evidence of distinctiveness, and, where applicable, the prior ministerial authorization for any sensitive token. The registry must resolve the administrative appeal within fifteen business days. If denied again, the applicant may file a 'demanda contencioso-administrativa' before the Sala Tercera de lo Contencioso-Administrativo de la Corte Suprema de Justicia within sixty days. A non-refundable filing fee applies at each administrative stage.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: For the bare formation of a Panama Sociedad Anónima, the statutory office may initially be the physical office of the licensed registered agent; however, for the licensed cross-border remittance business, a true virtual office or shared mail-drop address is not permissible. The applicant must demonstrate physical operational premises in Panama, with local compliance personnel, AML/CFT records, and corporate books accessible on-site before the money-transmission license is issued.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High; the quantified risk of an unannounced on-site inspection by the Superintendencia de Bancos, the UAF, or other competent AML authority within the first full year of operation is estimated at 85%. Enhanced inspection probability applies throughout the licensing process.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Official name search and reservation fee before the Registro Público de Panamá
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the Registro Público fee schedule; non-refundable

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent acceptance and statutory representation in Panama
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing annual market benchmark for corporate registered-agent services

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and protocolization of the incorporation instrument and appointment of initial directors
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing Panamanian notarial tariff per page and per protocolization sheet

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille or consular legalization bundle for foreign corporate and personal due-diligence documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Hague Apostille competent authority or consular section of the country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory apostille/consular fees plus accredited courier handling

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Spanish translation of all foreign-language documents by a Panama certified public translator
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Panama certified public translator (Traductor Público Autorizado)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing rate per certified translation page, as recognized by the Panamanian translator association

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT KYC, OFAC/UN/PEP screening, UBO registry filing, and sanctions-risk assessment
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed registered agent and compliance provider, with UAF registry stamp fees
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark per principal plus statutory UBO-registry filing costs

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley General de Sociedades Anónimas (Law 32 of 1927, as amended by Law 5 of 1977 and subsequent reforms), Articles 1–58 (formation and share capital), 52 (registered office), and 56–70 (directors and officers); complementary Código de Comercio registration provisions.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección de Personas Jurídicas (Public Registry of Panama, Legal Persons Section)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública (Public Deed of Incorporation) inscribed through the Registro Público de Panamá
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No legal minimum paid-up capital; articles may declare authorized capital of USD 10,000.00 or any other sum agreed by incorporators, payable as determined by the board; no escrow account is required by law.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: This First Board Resolution, adopted on [date], confirms the subscription and allotment of shares as recorded in the incorporation deed, in accordance with the company's authorized capital. The registered office is fixed at the location specified in the deed, and the registered agent is directed to record any changes with the Public Registry of Panama. The following officers are appointed: President, Secretary, and Treasurer, each vested with the powers conferred by the articles of incorporation. Management is authorized to apply for the necessary operating licenses, tax registrations, and bank accounts. It is further resolved that a copy of this resolution be certified and filed with the corporate records. This resolution is effective immediately upon adoption.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección de Personas Jurídicas
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the Registro Público online portal (site-required) or visit the registry window; complete the name search form for the proposed corporate name; obtain a certificate of non-conflict and reserve the name for 30 days.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is unavailable, the registry issues an adverse availability notice; resubmit with alternative names via the same form within one business day.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Public Deed Before a Notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública de la República de Panamá
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Cause the incorporation deed to be signed by all incorporators before a licensed Panamanian notary; include articles of incorporation, registered agent appointment, and initial share subscription; obtain notarial seals.
required_dossiers: Passport or identity card of each incorporator and director
Registered agent acceptance and power of attorney
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies defects, execute a corrective margin note and re-execute the affected portion before notarial re-sealing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección de Personas Jurídicas
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarized public deed for inscription through the registry's online 'Personas Jurídicas' module or at the physical window; append the name certificate and proof of fee payment; obtain the inscription number.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a 'Nota de Advertencia' (caution notice), submit clarifications and supporting documentation within 10 business days; after cure, request re-inscription.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtaining Legal Existence and Registry Certificates
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Certifications Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After inscription, apply for a 'Certificado de Registro y Personalidad Jurídica' (legal existence certificate) and a 'Paz y Salvo' (good standing) certificate to be used for corporate banking and licensing.
required_dossiers: Certificate fee payment receipt (USD 20 per certificate)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If certificate contains data entry errors, submit a written correction request to the registry; certificates are reissued within 2 business days after correction.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration and Municipal Operation Notice
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) – Registro Único de Contribuyentes (RUC) and Municipalidad de Panamá (Aviso de Operación)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the S.A. with DGI to obtain the RUC; file the municipal 'Aviso de Operación' and obtain the operating notice for the registered office address; retain evidence for further licensing.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipal record does not match the registry data, update the registered office with the Public Registry first, then re-apply for the Aviso; for RUC issues, correct the taxpayer details at DGI within 5 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP) – Dirección de Empresas de Remesas y Pagos Electrónicos
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licencia de Operación para Empresas de Transmisión de Fondos y Remesas (Cross-Border Money Transmission Service License)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – Category I (Service sector office; no full EIA required)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No point-source discharges or emissions applicable; compliance with General Environmental Law (Law 41 of 1998) regarding office solid waste segregation, electronic waste disposal, and energy efficiency standards.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá; structural load inspection for office premises; occupational health and safety registration with Ministerio de Trabajo y Desarrollo Laboral (MITRADEL); workplace health clearance from Ministerio de Salud (MINSA).

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas; e-services and fiscal portal 'T@ Pagás' and the FEPA electronic invoicing platform (https://www.dgi.gob.pa).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1. Obtain the definitive certificate of incorporation of the Sociedad Anónima from the Public Registry of Panama and appoint a licensed resident agent and a resident legal representative. 2. As a precondition for ISIC 6619, secure the remittance-company operating licence from the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (Acuerdo 1-2022) and the AML/CFT registration with the Unidad de Análisis Financiero under Ley 23 de 2015. 3. File the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente) application with the DGI through the T@ Pagás portal or service window, supplying the certified corporate documents, power of attorney, identification of the legal representative, and proof of the local registered office. 4. Request simultaneous ITBMS taxpayer registration in the same RUC file; the DGI assigns a 10-digit RUC and activates the VAT account. 5. Apply to the corresponding Municipality for the Aviso de Operación, and register the company with the CSS if payroll is maintained. Non-resident shareholders are permitted; a Panamanian resident agent is mandatory.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Panama does not operate an IRS-style check-the-box election; the S.A. is by law an entity-level taxpayer subject to the territorial source doctrine (only Panamanian-source income is taxed). Available statutory elections: (i) the SEM (Sede de Empresa Multinacional) regime under Law 41 of 2007, which permits a single 5% income tax on qualifying international services and zero-rated inbound services for licensed multinational centres; (ii) the small taxpayer (pequeño contribuyente) simplified ITBMS regime for gross annual income up to B/.36,000; (iii) the Panama Pacifico special economic zone regime; and (iv) the exempt-return filing position taken when the S.A. derives no Panamanian-source income. Hybrid-mismatch elections are not recognised; the DGI applies the statutory sourcing rules of the Código Fiscal and does not give effect to unilateral hybrid-payment deductions.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS – Impuesto a las Transferencias de Bienes Muebles y Servicios (Value Added Tax). Operative standard rate on the dossier date: 7%; the Fiscal Reform Law No. 447 of 30 January 2025 provides for a general rate increase to 9% tied to statutory triggers and publication by the DGI.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No de-minimis turnover threshold: registration for ITBMS is mandatory from the commencement of habitual taxable activity (transfer of goods or rendering of services) in Panamanian territory. A simplified presumptive regime exists only for small taxpayers whose gross annual revenue does not exceed B/.36,000; such taxpayers may register in the pequeño contribuyente category instead of the standard ITBMS return cycle.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: The FEPA electronic invoicing mandate is fully phased in for all ITBMS taxpayers. Invoices must be issued through DGI-authorised issuers, transmitted in real time to the DGI via the FEPA API (SOAP/REST web services), and completed with a DGI-issued authorisation code and QR code. The recipient must accept or reject the electronic invoice in the T@ Pagás portal; no physical fiscal stamp or pre-printed authorisation form remains valid. The DGI performs central validation, and any correction or credit note must also be transmitted and authorised in the FEPA environment.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of services qualify for the 0% ITBMS rate when the service is rendered in or outside Panama to a non-resident beneficiary for use or benefit outside Panama, under Article 1059 and related provisions of the Código Fiscal. For ISIC 6619 cross-border remittance rails, the Panamanian S.A. must evidence that the remittance fee is contractually charged to, and actually settled by, the non-resident money transmitter or aggregator abroad, that the economic exploitation of the administrative, matching, clearing and payout-management services occurs outside Panama, and that the proceeds are credited from abroad. Domestic cash-pickup fees deducted separately from the local beneficiary settlement are domestic services and remain subject to ITBMS at the operative rate. Goods exported in the business (if any) require a customs DUA and movement evidence.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DUA) for any goods component
Bill of Lading, Airway Bill, or SWIFT MT103 evidencing the cross-border payment rail
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank credit advice showing receipt of the foreign fee
Executed service agreement with the non-resident principal documenting the ISIC 6619 scope
Tax residence certificate of the foreign counterparty and DGI export-service registration records
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The DGI may audit zero-rating claims for up to five fiscal years and may claw back the full underpaid ITBMS at the operative rate together with statutory moratory interest and monthly surcharges where the documentation bundle is incomplete. Habitual or fabricated export claims attract fines from B/.500 to B/.50,000, a penalty of 100% to 200% of the tax evaded, and, where the amount exceeds the statutory criminal threshold, prosecution for tax fraud with imprisonment of two to five years; the UAF and Superintendencia de Bancos may concurrently suspend or revoke the remittance licence.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP) - de facto banking regulator in a fully dollarized system; there is no traditional emission central bank, with monetary policy superseded by use of the U.S. dollar as legal tender.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Panama operates under full dollarization: the U.S. dollar is legal tender, while the Balboa exists solely as a fractional coin unit. There are no foreign exchange controls, no dual-exchange-rate regimes, and no restrictions on capital or current account transactions. Profit remittance, dividend payments, and capital repatriation are permitted without FX authorization; however, they remain subject to AML/KYC documentation, territorial tax compliance, and the applicable 5% or 10% dividend withholding tax where earnings are taxable in Panama. The only practical hurdles arise from financial crime due diligence and bank compliance, not from exchange controls.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Panama maintains no mandatory export proceeds surrender regime, no conversion quotas, and no statutory time limit for repatriation of export receipts. Exporters may retain funds in any freely convertible currency or in U.S. dollar deposit accounts at Panamanian banks.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Moderate. Panama lacks a dedicated electronic money institution (EMI) licensing regime. Offshore digital EMIs cannot directly access national clearing rails or SBP-supervised settlement and must operate through a licensed Panamanian bank or a fintech company admitted under the SBP financial technology development framework. Legal constraints include a de facto physical-presence expectation, strict AML/CFT registration with the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF), and the need to execute a formal correspondent or agent agreement with a local bank. For the high-risk remittance business segment, offshore EMI viability is low unless a full local license or a substantial banking partnership is secured.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mandatory physical appearance generally applies to all natural-person signatories, directors, and ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) for newly formed Sociedades Anónimas in the high-risk money-transmission sector. Panamanian banks require in-person KYC interviews, wet signatures on internal forms, and original identification documents; remote account opening is not typically available for high-risk remittance licensees, although a bank may consider a controlled remote process where the applicant has an existing premier relationship, a qualified introducer, or a recognized correspondent bank reference.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Undocumented or unlicensed money transmission / remittance agency activity without registration with the UAF or SBP.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid UAF/SBP operating registration or pending application, the remittance agency license, corporate charter and bylaws, compliance officer appointment certificate, and documented AML/CFT policies aligned with Ley 23 de 2015 and FATF standards.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque ownership structure involving bearer shares, Private Interest Foundation (PIF), or nominee directors that obscures the UBO chain.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized registry of beneficial owners, sworn declarations of shareholding and foundation beneficiaries, underlying commercial agreements proving economic substance, audited or reviewed financial statements, and a formal source-of-wealth and source-of-funds report.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume, small-denomination cash pick-up settlement pattern typical of remittance corridors generating risk of money laundering or terrorist financing.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Transaction monitoring and reporting procedures, daily or periodic returns to the UAF, customer risk-rating software, business continuity records, agent network supervision contracts, and sample cash pick-up settlement reconciliations with supporting invoices.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border correspondent relationships or beneficiary jurisdictions with OFAC, FATF, or EU sanctions exposure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: OFAC and consolidated sanctions screening logs, negative news monitoring results, blacklisted jurisdiction procedures, transaction filtering evidence, written correspondent due diligence policies, and legal opinion confirming compliance with sanctions laws.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital contributions are structured as SWIFT MT103 customer transfers or MT202 bank-to-bank transfers in U.S. dollars, routed through Fedwire, CHIPS, or the correspondent banking network. The payment reason must clearly designate 'Capital Contribution' or 'Investment' to classify the entry as a capital-account item. No prior SBP or FX authorization is required. Standard verification includes: bank name screen, OFAC/sanctions filtering on both originator and beneficiary, UBO alignment with the capital escrow account records, and matching the wire advice against the executed investment agreement.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade settlements are executed via SWIFT MT103 for direct irrevocable payments, SWIFT MT700/MT707 for documentary letters of credit and amendments, and MT202/MT202COV for bank-to-bank liquidity transfers. For domestic vendor payments and cash pick-up disbursements, the Panamanian ACH (Cámara de Compensación Automatizada) and local check-clearing rails are used, with net settlement in U.S. dollars. Subsidiary liquidity accounts are prefunded in segregated USD demand deposit accounts, and transaction reporting is aligned with ISO 20022 pain.001/pain.002 and camt.053/054 statement-based reconciliation.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable foreign exchange forwards against USD crosses for freely convertible currencies (EUR, GBP, CHF, CAD, MXN, COP)
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for restricted or less-liquid currencies (e.g., CNY, VES, ARS, NGN) referencing the relevant fixing rate
Cross-currency interest rate swaps for medium-term USD versus foreign-currency funding obligations
FX options and simple FX option strategies for hedging specific remittance corridor cash flows

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax (Tasa Única Anual) for Sociedad Anónima
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas, collection via Banco Nacional de Panamá
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due by January 31 of each calendar year; reduced rate B/.300 if paid on or before January 31, otherwise B/.400
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Automatic surcharge to B/.400 after January 31; continued non-payment for three consecutive fiscal years triggers administrative dissolution and strike-off by the Registro Público de Panamá

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Informative Income Tax Return (Declaración de Renta)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filing due by March 31 following the close of the fiscal year (fiscal year = calendar year)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fine of 5% of tax liability (minimum B/.50) plus 1% monthly default interest; DGI may attach bank accounts and deny the Paz y Salvo tax clearance for ongoing non-compliance

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) Confirmation Declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro de Beneficiarios Finales, Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within 30 days of the corporate anniversary of initial registration; calendar-year filers due by March 31
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines under Ley 254 de 2021 (up to B/.10,000); temporary suspension of corporate filings and registration acts before the Registro Público until declaration is regularized

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Audited Financial Statements and Compliance Report for Remittance License
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP), AML Supervisor (Unidad de Análisis Financiero – UAF) for report copy
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after fiscal year-end (March 31) or as specified in SBP license conditions
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: SBP administrative fines for non-submission; continued failure may result in suspension or revocation of the cross-border money transmission license

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit if annual gross income exceeds USD 3,000,000; additionally, any licensed money remittance / payment institution supervised by the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá must file audited financial statements regardless of revenue size
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS (NIIF) as adopted in Panama; NIIF para PYMES permitted for non-public-interest entities not subject to SBP consolidated supervision

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Each Sociedad Anónima must file an annual beneficial owner confirmation with the MEF Registry; any transfer of shares exceeding 5% of capital must be updated in the registry within 30 days and included in the annual confirmation; non-compliance blocks corporate acts at the Registro Público
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors and Officers (Registro de Directores)
Minute Book of Board of Directors' Meetings
Statutory Accounting Ledgers (Libro Diario, Libro Mayor, Libro de Inventario y Balance)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 250–600 per annum (combined resident agent and registered office package)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 4,000–12,000 (SBP-scoped audit with AML/remittance compliance procedures)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial taxation: income derived exclusively from sources outside Panama is exempt. Eligible small and medium taxpayers under Law 54 of 2019 may apply progressive rates of 15% on the first B/.200,000, 18% on the next B/.150,000, and 20% on the next B/.150,000 of Panamanian-source taxable income; the 25% standard rate applies above B/.500,000. No sector-specific tax holiday applies.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 410 (Declaración Jurada del Impuesto sobre la Renta – Personas Jurídicas) filed electronically through the DGI e-Tax 2.0 (T@X) portal; separate Informe de Precios de Transferencia (Form 980) is required for related-party transactions above the threshold.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (one final return per fiscal year); quarterly advance income-tax deposits and monthly withholding/ITBM returns apply during the year.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within three months after the fiscal year-end; for calendar-year corporations, no later than 31 March of the following year, unless extended by official DGI calendar publication.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registro Único de Contribuyentes identification of the S.A.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the permanent Panamanian RUC assigned to the remittance licensee; non-resident beneficial owners are not recorded in this field.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fiscal period covered, in DD/MM/YYYY format from date to date.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Match the 12-month period ending on the license anniversary or calendar year; foreign-source income periods are included for informational reconciliation only.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: All gross commissions, foreign-exchange margins, fees, and float interest derived from Panamanian remittance clearing and payout services.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Exclude income generated by the expatriate-corridor collect/payout model where the receiver location and agent counterparty are outside Panama; retain transfer pricing source documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible operating expenses, bank and SWIFT clearing charges, agent commissions, salaries of Panamanian employees, rent, and amortisation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Expenses attributable to foreign-source revenue are not deductible against Panamanian taxable income; apply a consistent pro-rata allocation based on revenue source.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net Panamanian-source taxable profit before tax credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If management and board decisions occur outside Panama, document the absence of a Panamanian permanent establishment for the foreign corridor activities to avoid recharacterisation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 25% tax on taxable profit reduced by quarterly advance payments, withholding tax credits, and tax payments made abroad on Panamanian-source income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders must ensure the related dividend withholding tax is remitted; credit balances may be claimed as a refund in accordance with DGI administrative procedures.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final balance payable to the DGI or balance in favour of the taxpayer.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Pay through the T@X portal using the DGI deposit account; non-payment by the board triggers personal director liability mechanics.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: administrative fine from B/.50 to B/.5,000 plus a 10% surcharge on the unpaid tax and 1% monthly interest (Fiscal Code Art. 706-A); late payment interest accrues from the statutory due date. Unfiled returns beyond six months may lead to summary assessment and inclusion in the DGI 'lista de morosos', blocking public tenders and banking facilities.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Non-resident shareholder must file a DTA relief request with the DGI before the distribution, attaching: (i) a Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) issued by the foreign tax authority, (ii) a beneficial-ownership declaration, and (iii) a Panamanian fiscal agent power of attorney. The DGI issues a reduced-withholding authorisation; otherwise the statutory 10% dividend WHT must be withheld and remitted through the DGI monthly withholding return.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties for software, trade names, and processing systems of Panamanian source paid to non-residents: 12.5% statutory WHT; treaty relief typically 5–10%. Interest paid to non-resident creditors on Panamanian-source obligations: 12.5% statutory WHT, unless the credit is a registered foreign loan exempt under the Fiscal Code or the beneficial owner is entitled to a reduced treaty rate (commonly 0–10%).

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: B/.2,000,000 (Balboas, pegged to USD 1:1): mandatory Local File and transactional documentation for taxpayers with related-party transactions above the threshold in the fiscal year; Master File is additionally required where the multinational group consolidated revenue exceeds B/.50,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable. The licensed remittance S.A. is tax-resident and subject to Panama's Economic Substance Regulations: it must maintain a physical workplace in Panama, qualified employees including a compliance officer, board meetings and accounting records in Panama, and capital commensurate with remittance volume. ESR failure permits the DGI to treat the entity as a shell, recharacterise foreign-source fees as Panamanian-source, deny WHT treaty relief, and apply a 10% surcharge on the recalculated tax base.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax evasion / fraudulent income tax return
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Intentionally omitting SWIFT and local-cash-pickup clearing commissions from gross Panamanian-source revenue, or classifying Panamanian float interest as tax-exempt foreign-source income without supporting documentation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal fine of ten to fifty times the evaded tax and imprisonment from two to five years (Criminal Code Articles 280–281); administrative surcharge of 10% plus monthly interest; disqualification from DGI tax-cleanance certificates.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign or direct the false return are jointly and severally liable for the evaded tax and civil restitution; criminal conviction may trigger travel bans, asset freezing, and attachment of personal assets under fiscal criminal procedure.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell company / absence of economic substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the Panamanian S.A. and remittance license while all operational decisions, personnel, and treasury functions are performed abroad; filing an annual return relying exclusively on foreign-source income without demonstrating local management.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative nullity of the income tax return, retroactive assessment of 25% on deemed Panamanian-source revenue, 10% surcharge, fines up to B/.50,000, and revocation of the SBP money-transmission license.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee directors face DGI veil-piercing proceedings with court-ordered restitution of avoided tax, travel restrictions while debts are outstanding, and disqualification from managing regulated financial entities.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the cross-border payout corridor without the SBP 'Empresa de Transmisión de Fondos' license, or continuing remittance activity with no AML/CFT internal controls and no UAF suspicious-transaction reporting.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines under Law 23 of 2015 from B/.100,000 to B/.500,000, immediate revocation of the special license, and criminal money-laundering penalties of up to five years' imprisonment and fines up to B/.5,000,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners knowingly concerned may be prosecuted alongside the corporate entity; exposure includes personal financial restitution, international travel bans, and extradition under mutual legal assistance treaties.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying dividends to non-resident shareholders without the 10% dividend WHT, or invoking treaty relief without an approved TRC and DGI relief order.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Withheld tax treated as unpaid; 10% surcharge and 1% monthly interest; mandatory inclusion in the DGI delinquent taxpayers registry and automatic loss of low-risk taxpayer status.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who resolved the dividend are personally liable as 'contribuyente sustituto' for the unpaid WHT; criminal complaint may be filed for misappropriation of retained tax, with travel bans imposed until the debt is fully settled.
